name: Reprolith bootstrap PK/PD blind test set
description: The labelled PK/PD test set for the ode-pkpd MVP (bootstrap task 1.4). Ground-truth reproducibility labels come from BioModels' curation status: a model in the manually-curated (BIOMD) branch reproduces its reference publication's results, so its expected verdict is `reproduced`; a model in the non-curated (MODEL) branch was not validated to reproduce from the manuscript alone, so its expected verdict is `not-reproduced`.
label_basis: BioModels manual-curation status. See Tiwari et al. 2021, 'Reproducibility in systems biology modelling', Mol Syst Biol (doi:10.15252/msb.20209982): ~49% of published models did not reproduce from the manuscript, and these remained outside the curated branch. Curation status is therefore an independent reproducibility signal, not Reprolith's own verdict.
caveat: Non-curated status means 'not validated to reproduce from the manuscript', which is the intended known-hard signal but is weaker than a documented per-model reproduction failure; a non-curated model that is simply awaiting review could still reproduce. Labels are blind to Reprolith's verdict path and used only for post-hoc agreement. The label is also INFERABLE from the accession: curation status is the BioModels branch, and the branch is the accession prefix, so the rule 'accession starts with BIOMD -> reproduced' scores 31/31 here. The accession travels with the blind entry, so this set cannot demonstrate blind discriminative skill on its own — an agent guessing from the prefix would outscore honest work. What it does establish is that Reprolith abstains rather than guesses: 30 of 31 entries are blocked, with zero wrong verdicts. Read the agreement numbers as evidence about abstention discipline, not classification skill; the latter needs a label source independent of the identifier.
